reasons.overall_mobile: Clear objective progression, coherent atmosphere and useful assistance made both sampled missions understandable. Portrait target size, crowded overlays and cover/no-impact feedback cost clarity. Paused assisted runs leave substantial manual-control and continuous-play uncertainty.
reasons.controls: Large anchored buttons, tap aim, TURN and two-contact MOVE/FIRE worked in brief samples. Scene swipe visibly turned, AIM showed sights. Precision, sustained manual traversal and physical ergonomics remain unassessed; assisted travel does not establish these.
reasons.gameplay: Observed sequence of recovery, coil disable and upload provided clear changing tasks with damage and reload decisions. Short assisted completion and segmented combat limit judgment of sustained challenge or enjoyment.
reasons.presentation: Cohesive teal/amber industrial rain scene, strong title and terminal hierarchy, clear target/coil feedback. Dark geometry and overlapping scene text reduce visual clarity. Audio excluded.
reasons.usability: Visible handbook, contextual HOLD APPROACH, SAVED confirmation, paused planning map and readable fresh-start results reduced uncertainty. Several competing prompts and cover states still demand interpretation.
reasons.readability: Primary health/ammo/objective and terminal stats readable; small world lettering, Roman numerals, distant enemies and instructional overlays are harder to parse in 390px portrait.
